title: Practical Edge Detection via Robust Collaborative Learning (PEdger)
mechanism: Collaborative learning between models from different training moments and heterogeneous architectures (recurrent and not) to resist noisy labels, with no pretraining.
adaptation: An EMA teacher plus a second architecture trained on labelled data only, with crack consistency used as label denoising at 100% labels.
min_experiment: Arm: house + EMA and heterogeneous co-learning on labelled data, 5 seeds. Baseline: house at 100% labels. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill if n.d.
evidence: R: better accuracy, speed and size on BSDS500 and NYUD without pretraining. Numbers not read.
prior_overlap: Partly closed: Mean Teacher at 100% with the pool was n.d., and CPS at 5% was worse. Its use for denoising labelled data at 100% is untested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Supervised EMA teacher plus a second architecture on labelled cells only, consistency on the crack channel.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + EMA teacher consistency on labelled data, 5 seeds; baseline house. Kill if crack IoU n.d.
